title: MMTEB: MASSIVE MULTILINGUAL TEXT EMBEDDING BENCHMARK
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured model performance on tasks involving religious texts, specifically bitext mining (finding parallel sentences across languages) and clustering of texts from the Bible. The goal was to evaluate text embedding quality on this domain, not to measure bias, stereotypes, or theological knowledge.
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to the religious domain. The analysis focuses on overall model performance across different languages, task types, and model sizes, concluding that smaller, highly multilingual models can outperform larger models (like Mistral-7B variants) in multilingual and low-resource settings.
